chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
There is no salat over a جنازة when a woman is with it.
Thus, the sound interpretation of this narration is that it indicates a degree of dislike, not prohibition.

key_terms.الْكَرَاهِيَةِ: dislike or reprehensibility in legal usage, short of prohibition
key_terms.امْرَأَةٌ: a woman present with the funeral procession or bier
key_terms.جِنَازَةٍ: a funeral bier or deceased person over whom funeral prayer is offered
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: salat, here referring to the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Is funeral salat over a جنازة invalid or merely disliked when a woman is present?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling of performing salat over a جنازة when a woman is present with it. The concluding statement clarifies that the report is understood as indicating karāhah (dislike) rather than an outright prohibition, placing it within jurisprudential discussion of funeral prayer.
